surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process does not include any oxygen sources through entire chemical reactions and consequently it is expected that the formation of antimony oxides will be greatly suppressed. The thickness of Sb 2S3 layer on blvTiO 2/FTO substrate can be also precisely controlled as shown in Figure 1b because the formation of Sb 2S3 is physically controlled by the repeated chemical reaction of the specific amount of precursors.
